## Technical & Professional Skills Taxonomy

### 1. Search Engine Optimization (SEO & AEO & GEO)
- **Technical SEO**: Core Web Vitals optimization, site speed architecture, XML sitemaps, robots.txt configuration, canonicalization, crawl budget management, structured data (Schema.org JSON-LD).
- **On-Page SEO**: Keyword intent mapping, semantic content structure, meta tag optimization, heading hierarchy, internal linking architecture, image optimization.
- **Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**: Optimizing structured snippets for Google AI Overviews, voice assistants (Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa), and featured snippets.
- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)**: Structuring contextual entities, statistics, and machine-readable data for generative LLMs (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Claude, Gemini).
- **SEO & Web Analytics Tools**: Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console (GSC), Keyword Planner, Screaming Frog SEO Spider fundamentals.

### 2. Digital Marketing & Content Strategy
- Social Media Strategy & Organic Growth
- Content Planning, Editorial Scheduling & Copywriting
- Brand Identity & Narrative Storytelling
- Campaign Performance Tracking & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

### 3. Business Intelligence & Data Visualization
- **IBM Cognos Analytics**: Report design, multidimensional data modeling, dashboard creation, business intelligence metrics.
- **Visual Design & Media Tools**: Canva, CapCut, Affinity Designer.

### 4. Web Development & Front-End Engineering
- **Languages & Standards**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+)
- **Design & Performance**: Responsive Web Design, Mobile-First UI/UX, Glassmorphism, Micro-animations, CSS Grid & Flexbox, Cross-Browser Compatibility.
